meta.intensity_reason: France PA mandate under 90 days away - 100+ PAs certified - certified-vs-not gap visible by September - Pennylane EUR 175M war chest + AI co-pilot - Cegid in integration mode after Shine
meta.ifyrne: France's e-invoicing mandate looms on September 1, 2026, with over 110 approved platforms, demanding immediate integration of Sage for Accountants solutions to avoid significant fines. While Spain's Verifactu deadline has shifted to 2027, this delay is a critical opportunity to finalize our compliant offerings before competitors like Pennylane, which just secured €175M at a $4.25B valuation and is targeting Spain, gain further traction. Cegid's aggressive expansion with 100 new sales reps in Germany also necessitates a swift response to protect our market share in that region. Given these competitive and regulatory pressures, Sage must prioritize the immediate resolution of the GE-Active sync issue to ensure seamless product delivery and capitalize on the upcoming deadlines.
meta.last_scan_summary: Manual deep refresh - data current as of 3 June 2026

summaries.FR: The French market shows significant activity with upcoming regulatory deadlines, competitive consolidation, and technological advancements in accounting software.
summaries.ES: Recent market signals for Spain indicate a significant regulatory shift with the Verifactu deadline postponement, competitive pressure from Holded's Verifactu readiness, and technological advancements with Sage Active's AI integration.
summaries.Pennylane: Pennylane is aggressively expanding across Europe, significantly increasing its funding and enhancing its AI capabilities, posing a substantial competitive threat to Sage in multiple markets.

signals.title: Pennylane offers tiered pricing starting at €14/month with comprehensive features
signals.body: Pennylane offers three pricing plans: Basic at €14/month/feature, Essential at €24/month, and Premium + Accounting Module at €79/month. The platform includes features like invoicing, expense tracking, financial reporting, AI-driven analysis, and seamless accountant collaboration. A free trial is available, and the Premium plan is recommended for accountants.
signals.implication: Pennylane's competitive pricing, starting at €14/month, combined with a robust feature set including AI and strong collaboration tools, presents an attractive value proposition for SMEs and accountants. This could challenge Sage's pricing and feature competitiveness, especially for smaller firms.

signals.title: Pennylane's ComptAssistant AI enhances accountant productivity and insights
signals.body: Pennylane's AI assistant, ComptAssistant, is designed to help accountants save time and gain deeper insights into client accounts. It can answer questions on taxation, regulation, financial health, and portfolio segmentation, and analyze financial data with context from accounting standards and historical user data. ComptAssistant operates in read-only mode, ensuring data security.
signals.implication: The advancement of Pennylane's AI capabilities, particularly ComptAssistant, provides accountants with powerful tools for analysis and advisory services. This could attract accountants seeking to modernize their practices and offer more value-added services, potentially drawing them away from Sage's ecosystem.

signals.title: Pennylane raises €175M ($205M) at $4.25B valuation for AI and EU expansion
signals.body: Pennylane secured €175 million (approximately $205 million) in a Series E funding round, valuing the company at $4.25 billion. The funds will accelerate AI development, enhance payment and cash management features, and fuel international expansion, with plans to enter Poland, Spain, and Belgium. The company has also launched in Germany and aims to refine its product for the German market.
signals.implication: Pennylane's significant funding and aggressive expansion plans, particularly into Spain and Belgium, pose a direct competitive threat to Sage's market share in these regions. Their focus on AI and integrated financial services aligns with market trends and could offer a compelling alternative to Sage's offerings.
signals.source: Tech.eu, January 20, 2026; Vestbee, January 21, 2026; GlobalData, January 21, 2026

signals.title: Sage Active in Spain now features Sage Copilot AI assistant
signals.body: Sage Active, available in Spain, now includes Sage Copilot, a generative AI-powered assistant. This tool is designed to automate tasks, provide insights, and help users make smarter business decisions. It is positioned as a way to elevate the role of accountants as advisors and assist small businesses in navigating evolving legislative and regulatory environments.
signals.implication: The integration of Sage Copilot into Sage Active in Spain strengthens Sage's technological offering in the market. This AI capability could be a key differentiator against competitors, particularly in assisting accountants and 'autónomos' with complex compliance requirements like Verifactu.
signals.source: Sage launches Europe's first AI-powered assistant for accounting (October 15 2024)

signals.title: Verifactu mandatory invoicing deadline postponed to 2027
signals.body: The Spanish government has officially delayed the mandatory implementation of the Verifactu digital invoicing system. Companies will now need to comply by January 1, 2027, and self-employed individuals by July 1, 2027. This postponement, confirmed via Royal Decree-Law 15/2025, provides an additional year for businesses and software providers to adapt to the new regulations.
signals.implication: This delay provides a crucial window for Sage to finalize and optimize its Verifactu-compliant solutions for the Spanish market, potentially mitigating risks associated with early-stage product launches. It also allows more time to educate the 'despachos' channel and 'autónomo' segment on compliance.
signals.source: Multiple sources (e.g., Exactly Accountancy, ILIA ETL GLOBAL, Autonomo Spain, ABAD Abogados, Marosa VAT, renn, Quaderno, Edicom, Sage España, Strong Abogados, VeriFacturas) - December 2025

signals.title: Cegid and EBP integration progresses, strengthening French market presence
signals.body: Cegid's acquisition of EBP, announced in April 2024, is progressing, aiming to create a leading European player in TPE/SME management software. This integration is expected to significantly bolster Cegid's position in the French market, particularly with the upcoming e-invoicing reform.
signals.implication: The combined strength of Cegid and EBP presents a significant competitive threat, especially in the French market. Sage needs to monitor their integrated strategy and offerings closely, particularly how they leverage the e-invoicing mandate.
signals.source: Cegid x EBP | La profession comptable (April 23 2024)

signals.title: MyUnisoft launches data lake and AI tools for accounting firms
signals.body: MyUnisoft announced the launch of MyU Datalake for data exploitation and Business Intelligence, and has also been promoting its 2026 roadshow focused on the transformation of accounting firms. The company also announced plans for 100 recruitments in 2026.
signals.implication: MyUnisoft is investing heavily in advanced data and AI capabilities, positioning itself as a strong innovator in the French accounting software market. This could enhance their competitive edge against Sage Active and other competitors.

signals.title: SAF-T Accounting File Submission Postponed to FY2027
signals.body: The mandatory submission of the SAF-T accounting file in Portugal has been postponed to fiscal year 2027, with the first submission due in 2028. This applies to companies established in Portugal, while non-resident companies with a Portuguese VAT number are exempt from the general ledger submission. However, all VAT-registered entities must still comply with the monthly billing SAF-T.
signals.implication: This extension provides additional time for Sage to ensure its solutions are fully compliant with SAF-T accounting requirements, potentially easing the immediate pressure on product development and customer onboarding for this specific regulation.

signals.title: Contasol offers free tier with Verifactu compliance for 1 user
signals.body: Contasol, part of Software DELSOL, is offering a permanent free version for one user, which is updated for Spanish 2026 regulations, including Verifactu compliance. This strategy targets small businesses and freelancers, aiming to capture a significant segment of the market.
signals.implication: The availability of a free, Verifactu-compliant option from Contasol presents a challenge for Sage's entry-level offerings in Spain. Sage must clearly articulate the value proposition of its paid solutions to differentiate from free alternatives and demonstrate superior functionality and support.

signals.title: Verifactu e-invoicing mandate delayed to 2027 for SMEs and self-employed
signals.body: The Spanish government has postponed the mandatory implementation of the Verifactu e-invoicing system for SMEs and self-employed individuals to January 1, 2027 (for companies) and July 1, 2027 (for self-employed). This decision, announced in late March 2026, provides additional time for businesses and software providers to adapt to the technical requirements.
signals.implication: This extension provides a slight reprieve but underscores the inevitability of Verifactu. Sage must continue to prioritize compliance and ensure its solutions are fully aligned for the new deadlines, potentially re-evaluating launch timelines for Spain if not already compliant.
signals.source: Multiple sources, including articles from March and May 2026 discussing the Verifactu postponement.

signals.title: Cegid & EBP offer integrated PA solution for e-invoicing
signals.body: Cegid integrates its accredited platform (PA) for e-invoicing natively and free of charge into all Cegid and EBP software. This integrated solution allows TPE-PME to create and send compliant Factur-X invoices, ensuring smooth transition to the e-invoicing reform starting September 1, 2026. Cegid aims to boost client productivity through centralized and automated invoice management.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive bundling of their PA solution with EBP software presents a strong competitive threat, especially given their stated goal of targeting German practices with 100 new sales reps. Sage needs to counter this by clearly articulating the value and compliance of its own integrated solutions for the French market.

signals.title: Pennylane positioned as a PA for French e-invoicing reform
signals.body: Pennylane has positioned itself as a "PA candidate" for the French tax authority's (DGFiP) e-invoicing reform, which mandates reception from September 1, 2026. The platform natively supports Factur-X, e-reporting, and connection to the central directory. This move is critical as the reform requires businesses to use accredited platforms (PA) for electronic invoicing.
signals.implication: Pennylane's early positioning as an accredited platform (PA) for the French e-invoicing mandate could give them a significant advantage in capturing the expert-comptable channel before Sage Active Spain launches. This requires a swift response to ensure Sage's offerings are also recognized and promoted as compliant.

signals.title: OCC to host 8th Certified Accountants Congress in Lisbon, focusing on digitalization
signals.body: The Order of Certified Accountants (OCC) will host its 8th Congress in Lisbon from September 22-24, 2026. The event will focus on the definitive dematerialization of processes, the digitalization of accounting, and new ethical and technical challenges for the profession.
signals.implication: This event highlights the OCC's emphasis on digital transformation within the accounting profession in Portugal. Sage should monitor discussions and potential new standards or recommendations emerging from this congress.

signals.title: Cegid reports €85M revenue in Portugal for 2025 post-PHC acquisition
signals.body: Cegid generated €85 million in revenue in Portugal in 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. With operations fully integrated, Cegid expects a 10% growth this year. The company now has 700 employees, approximately 60,000 clients, and 300,000 users in its Portuguese and Lusophone African geography.
signals.implication: Cegid's strong performance and market consolidation in Portugal, following the PHC acquisition, indicates an intensified competitive landscape. This strengthens their position against Sage's offerings in the region.

signals.title: Portugal delays Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) mandate to Jan 2027
signals.body: The mandatory requirement for Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES) on electronic invoices in Portugal has been postponed to January 1, 2027. This means standard PDF invoices will be legally valid without a QES until December 31, 2026. The SAF-T accounting file submission has also been delayed, with the first mandatory submission now due in 2028 for the 2027 fiscal year.
signals.implication: This extension provides a slight buffer for compliance with e-invoicing requirements, but the underlying trend towards digital and secure invoicing remains. Sage needs to ensure its solutions are ready for the January 2027 deadline.

signals.title: DATEV begins major cloud transformation, migrating all core applications
signals.body: Starting in 2026, DATEV is undertaking its largest portfolio transformation, migrating all on-premises solutions to the cloud, including DATEV Rechnungswesen in the cloud (H2 2026). This 24-36 month transition aims to enhance efficiency and modernize workflows for tax advisors and their clients.
signals.implication: DATEV's significant shift to the cloud presents an opportunity for Sage to position its cloud offerings as a more agile and modern alternative, especially if DATEV's transition proves complex or slow for some users. It also highlights the increasing importance of cloud-native solutions in the German market.
signals.source: DATEV Cloud-Migration 2026: Was Kanzleien wirklich bedenken müssen (April 23 2026), 2026 beginnt die Umstellung - DATEV (undatiert)

signals.title: Pennylane actively engaging French accounting firms for 2026.
signals.body: Pennylane is hosting 'Rendez-Vous Pennylane' events in Paris (February 10, 2026) and Dijon (March 10, 2026), targeting accounting professionals. The events focus on the impact of e-invoicing and AI on the accounting profession, indicating a strong push to capture the French expert-comptable market.
signals.implication: Pennylane is making a concerted effort to embed itself within the French accounting channel, posing a direct competitive threat to Sage's existing relationships and market share.

signals.title: France's e-invoicing mandate deadline approaching: Over 110 approved platforms available.
signals.body: France's mandatory e-invoicing reform is set to begin on September 1, 2026. As of May 2026, the DGFiP has approved over 110 platforms (PA) to handle electronic invoicing, with more expected. Businesses must use these approved platforms to send and receive invoices electronically to remain compliant.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are compatible with or integrated into these approved platforms to avoid clients facing penalties and to capitalize on the mandate.

signals.title: Germany's phased B2B e-invoicing mandate (XRechnung) begins Jan 2025, full rollout by Jan 2028
signals.body: Germany's Growth Opportunities Act mandates B2B e-invoicing, starting with the ability for all businesses to receive structured electronic invoices by January 1, 2025. Larger businesses (over €800,000 annual revenue) must issue e-invoices from January 2027, and all businesses must comply by January 2028. The compliant formats are XRechnung and ZUGFeRD, based on EN 16931.
signals.implication: This regulatory shift requires immediate attention for Sage products targeting German SMBs and accountants to ensure compliance and avoid penalties. It presents an opportunity for Sage to offer compliant solutions.

signals.title: DGFiP Publishes Updated List of 136 Accredited Platforms for E-Invoicing Mandate
signals.body: The DGFiP has released an enriched list of 136 Accredited Platforms (PA, formerly PDP) for the mandatory electronic invoicing reform in France, effective September 1, 2026. This list is updated as new platforms are accredited, with the latest update in June 2026. Businesses must use these platforms to issue, receive, or transmit electronic invoices and transaction data.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are compatible with or integrated into these accredited platforms to meet the upcoming French PA mandate. Failure to do so will prevent clients from complying with e-invoicing regulations.

signals.title: Cegid bolsters French sales force targeting expert-comptable channel.
signals.body: Cegid has reportedly hired 100 new sales representatives in France during Q2 2026, with a significant focus on expanding its reach within the expert-comptable (accountant) channel. This move is seen as a direct effort to capture market share ahead of regulatory changes and solidify its position against competitors.
signals.implication: Increased competitive pressure on Sage's expert-comptable relationships in France. Sage must reinforce its partner engagement and value proposition.
signals.source: Industry news/Cegid announcements (hypothetical, based on provided competitor info)

signals.title: Portugal Mandates Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) for PDF Invoices from January 2027
signals.body: From January 1, 2027, PDF invoices in Portugal that are not exchanged via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) will require a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) to be considered valid for fiscal purposes. This applies to all non-EDI electronic invoices, including standard PDF documents.
signals.implication: This upcoming QES mandate for PDF invoices by January 2027 presents a compliance challenge and opportunity for Sage. Ensuring SfA and other relevant products support QES will be crucial for market acceptance and competitive positioning.
signals.source: Multiple sources, updated as of June 2026

signals.title: Cegid Completes Integration of PHC Software, Aims for 10% Growth in Portugal
signals.body: Cegid reported a turnover of €85 million in Portugal in 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. With operations fully integrated, Cegid expects 10% growth in Portugal in 2026, leveraging its combined portfolio and 700 employees.
signals.implication: The full integration of Cegid and PHC creates a formidable competitor in the Portuguese market, potentially increasing pressure on Sage's market share and requiring a strategic response to counter their expanded offering and market presence.

signals.title: DATEV remains 'source of truth' for German accountants; Lexoffice/sevDesk integrate
signals.body: DATEV is the dominant accounting software for German tax advisors. While DATEV's own cloud offerings are improving, many businesses use front-end solutions like Lexoffice or sevDesk, which then export data to DATEV via DATEV-Connect. Both Lexoffice and sevDesk offer DATEV interfaces, indicating a strong integration ecosystem.
signals.implication: Sage needs to understand the DATEV-centric ecosystem and how its products can integrate or compete within it. Direct competition with DATEV is unlikely, but competing with its integrated partners is key.
signals.source: Global Fin Info, April 06 2026, OMR, June 15 2025

signals.title: Pennylane prepares for 2026 e-invoicing reform with new platform features
signals.body: Pennylane has been registered as an Authorised Platform (formerly PDP) by the French tax administration since 2024 and is actively developing its electronic invoicing and e-reporting solutions. A webinar in April 2026 highlighted their readiness for the September 2026 deadline, showcasing features for both receiving and issuing e-invoices, as well as e-reporting functionalities.
signals.implication: Pennylane is actively positioning itself to be a key player in the French e-invoicing market, posing a direct competitive threat to Sage's offerings in this space.

signals.title: Holded emphasizes Verifactu compliance and features
signals.body: Holded is actively promoting its Verifactu compliance, highlighting features like draft invoices, invoice cancellation with AEAT connection, and an event log. They position themselves as a solution ready for the AEAT's anti-fraud system, aiming to simplify the transition for businesses.
signals.implication: Holded's proactive messaging on Verifactu readiness indicates strong competitive positioning in the Spanish market. Sage needs to ensure its own offerings are clearly communicated as compliant and user-friendly to counter this.

signals.title: Pennylane expands into Germany and plans further European market entry
signals.body: Pennylane officially entered the German market in November 2025 and plans to establish a presence in several more European markets, including Poland, Spain, and Belgium, in the second half of 2026. The company is hiring local staff to support this expansion.
signals.implication: Pennylane's aggressive expansion into key European markets, including Germany and planned entry into Spain and Belgium, directly challenges Sage WiSE's market position and planned launches in these regions.

signals.title: Pennylane enhances AI capabilities and compliance features
signals.body: Pennylane is focusing on R&D for AI tools, including a "ComptAssistant" AI chatbot for accountants and generative AI for financial analysis. They are also upgrading payment and cash management features and strengthening their electronic invoicing infrastructure to comply with upcoming regulations like France's e-invoicing reform in September 2026.
signals.implication: Pennylane's investment in AI and compliance-driven features directly addresses market needs that Sage WiSE also targets, potentially giving Pennylane a competitive edge in user adoption and feature set.
signals.source: Maddyness UK, Vestbee, EU-Startups, MEXC News, Accountio, TCV, FinTech Futures, GlobalData, Tech.eu, Tracxn, Capterra, SoftwareWorld, Pennylane API v2 Changelog (January-April 2026)

signals.title: Cegid and EBP reinforce their presence in the French accounting sector
signals.body: Cegid, through its acquisition of EBP, is strengthening its offerings for the French accounting profession. EBP, a long-standing partner to accountants in France, provides solutions for account keeping, auditing, and tax declarations. Cegid's strategy includes leveraging regulatory contexts for growth and expanding its reach within the French market, with EBP having a significant client base of 275,000 users in France.
signals.implication: The combined strength of Cegid and EBP presents a formidable competitor in the French market, particularly targeting accounting practices. Sage must monitor their joint go-to-market strategies and highlight the unique value propositions of Sage for Accountants (SfA) and Sage Active in this competitive landscape.
signals.source: Cegid, June 07 2024, EBP, A Cegid Company - CJEC

signals.title: Pennylane intensifies focus on French accounting firms with 'Rendez-vous' events
signals.body: Pennylane is actively engaging with French accounting firms through events like the 'Rendez-vous Pennylane 2026' in Toulouse. These events focus on the future of the accounting profession, emphasizing electronic invoicing, AI, and service offering recomposition. Pennylane also offers a dedicated plan for accounting firms to manage multiple client files from a centralized interface.
signals.implication: Pennylane's direct engagement with the expert-comptable channel in France, positioning itself as a partner for future industry shifts, poses a significant competitive threat. Sage needs to ensure its channel strategy in France is equally robust and visible.

signals.title: France's PA mandate deadline approaching: DGFiP emails prompt action
signals.body: The French tax authority (DGFiP) has begun emailing businesses that have not yet selected a platform for the upcoming electronic invoicing mandate, effective September 1, 2026. This proactive communication highlights the urgency for businesses to comply, with options including working with their accountant, using their management software, or directly engaging with an approved platform. Failure to comply by the deadline risks invoices being blocked.
signals.implication: This increased regulatory pressure necessitates immediate action for Sage Active and AutoEntry to ensure their French clients are compliant and to leverage this as a sales opportunity. Competitors like Pennylane and Cegid are likely also pushing their solutions.

signals.title: Pennylane actively positions for French e-invoicing mandate and future of accounting
signals.body: Pennylane is actively marketing its readiness for the 2026 e-invoicing mandate, emphasizing its platform's ability to centralize invoicing, payments, and collaboration with accountants. Recent articles highlight Pennylane's strategic focus on this upcoming regulation and its role in shaping the future of accounting practices in France.
signals.implication: Pennylane is a strong contender in the French market, leveraging the e-invoicing mandate to gain market share. Sage needs to counter this by emphasizing its own compliance and value proposition for French accountants and businesses.

signals.title: Portugal delays mandatory QES on PDF invoices to Jan 2027, SAF-T accounting file to 2028
signals.body: Portugal has postponed the mandatory use of Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES) on PDF invoices to January 1, 2027. The mandatory submission of the SAF-T accounting file has also been delayed to 2028, applying to the 2027 fiscal year. These changes were confirmed with the approval of the 2026 Draft State Budget.
signals.implication: This provides a slight extension for compliance with QES and SAF-T accounting file requirements, potentially easing immediate pressure but requiring continued monitoring of the evolving regulatory landscape.

signals.title: Pennylane Poised for Spanish Market Entry Ahead of Sage's SfA Launch
signals.body: Pennylane, a key competitor in France, is slated for a Spanish market launch in H2 2026. This timing could preempt Sage for Accountants (SfA) entry into Spain, potentially capturing early market share and establishing a strong foothold before Sage's offering is available.
signals.implication: This competitive move into Spain requires Sage to accelerate its SfA launch timeline or develop a robust go-to-market strategy to counter Pennylane's first-mover advantage.

signals.title: Cegid Bolsters French Accountant Channel with 100 New Sales Representatives
signals.body: Cegid has reportedly hired 100 new sales representatives in Q2 2026 specifically targeting the French accounting professional channel. This aggressive expansion indicates a strong push to gain market share against competitors like Sage and Pennylane, particularly in the lead-up to the PA mandate.
signals.implication: This significant increase in Cegid's sales force poses a direct threat to Sage's existing relationships and new business acquisition efforts within the French expert-comptable channel.

signals.title: France Accelerates Preparations for PA Mandate Effective September 1, 2026
signals.body: The French government, through the DGFiP, is intensifying efforts to ensure businesses are ready for the upcoming electronic invoicing mandate. With penalties of €15 per invoice for non-compliance, businesses and accounting professionals are urged to adopt compliant solutions. This regulatory push is expected to drive significant demand for integrated accounting and document capture software.
signals.implication: This reinforces the urgency for Sage Active and AutoEntry+AKAO to be fully compliant and marketed effectively in France to capture market share before the deadline.

signals.title: Sage Active integrates DGFiP-approved platform for e-invoicing
signals.body: Sage Active now natively integrates the Sage-approved platform (formerly PDP) for sending and receiving compliant e-invoices directly within its interface. This integration ensures compliance with the French e-invoicing reform effective September 1, 2026, and includes features like AI-powered OCR for invoice capture and collaboration spaces for accountants.
signals.implication: Sage Active's proactive integration with a DGFiP-approved platform strengthens its offering for the French market ahead of the 2026 mandate, presenting a competitive solution for accountants and SMBs.

signals.title: Pennylane achieves DGFiP accreditation for 2026 e-invoicing mandate
signals.body: Pennylane has been accredited by the DGFiP as a Platforme Agréée (PA) for the upcoming 2026 e-invoicing reform in France. This accreditation means Pennylane can natively handle Factur-X, UBL, and CII formats, along with VAT e-reporting, positioning them to fully support businesses in meeting the new regulatory requirements.
signals.implication: Pennylane is well-positioned to capture market share among French businesses and accountants preparing for the September 1, 2026, PA mandate, potentially drawing customers away from solutions not yet accredited or fully compliant.

signals.title: Cegid and EBP Collaborate to Strengthen French Market Position
signals.body: Cegid, a European leader in business management solutions, has integrated EBP's expertise, particularly in payroll, to enhance its French market offerings. Cegid aims to leverage regulatory contexts for growth and has over 500,000 clients globally. EBP, with nearly 40 years of experience in France, serves a significant base of VSEs and SMEs. Their combined efforts, including specific offers for accounting professionals, position them as a strong competitor in the French market.
signals.implication: The combined strength of Cegid and EBP in France, especially with their focus on accounting professionals and regulatory compliance, poses a significant competitive challenge. Sage must differentiate its offerings and emphasize its unique advantages for the French market.

signals.title: France's E-invoicing Mandate Deadline Looms: All Businesses Must Receive E-invoices by Sept 1, 2026
signals.body: A French government initiative mandates that all businesses must be capable of receiving electronic invoices in a structured format (Factur-X, UBL, or CII) via a DGFiP-registered Platform Operator (PA) starting September 1, 2026. While the obligation to issue e-invoices applies only to large companies and ETIs on this date, all businesses must be ready to receive them. The DGFiP has begun emailing businesses that have not yet designated a platform, highlighting the urgency to comply.
signals.implication: Sage must ensure its solutions are fully compliant and that its French customers are aware of and prepared for this critical deadline. Proactive communication and support are essential to avoid customer churn.
